messages:
Maya S.: quick heads up — we plan to deploy the roles schema change tonight 02:00 UTC. goal: migrate to deterministic role_hashes (role_name + tenant salt) to avoid the UID collisions we've seen. will touch default role backfill and the KMS signing flow. need infra + oncall to be aware.
Samir: can you outline the main rollout risks? is this destructive?
Maya S.: not destructive if canary goes well. risks: 1) backfill may time out on large orgs, 2) some legacy services expect numeric role ids and will 500 if mapping missing, 3) KMS call added to token generation path (latency/regional failures). plan: canary 5% orgs, feature-flagged fallback to legacy rolemap, migration in small batches.
Lee: what failure mode caused the collisions again? we should add a detection query before migration.
Maya S.: collisions came from concurrent seed jobs that used incremental counters across shards. new scheme uses a tenant-specific salt so names->hash is stable. detection query: count >1 where role_hash IS NULL OR role_hash collides.
Arjun K.: KMS note — token signing will call internal KMS via the new client. are we pinning region fallback? if KMS fails we should not block logins. propose async signing: issue token with k-signed header empty and enqueue sign job. audit logs mark unsigned.
Toni: audit logging: we must not lose who performed the migration. include migration_run_id in audit events and write to audit_index (ES). also add a dry-run mode to assert there are no missing default_role mappings.
Maya S.: agreed on migration_run_id. dry-run will run tonight at 00:30 UTC and produce a CSV of missing mappings for large orgs.
InfraBot: deploy job queued: role-migrate:v2 -> scheduled 02:00 UTC. canary group size 5% (ids provided). link: https://deploys.internal/role-migrate/1850
Samir: how long is the job expected to run for a full org? we need SLO to alert if >30m.
Maya S.: small orgs <5m rows -> ~5-10m. large orgs up to 3 hrs. we'll set per-org timeout and pause/resume.
Lee: add a pre-check: run this query and attach results to the deploy run:
```
SELECT org_id, count(*) as missing_defaults
FROM roles r
LEFT JOIN role_mappings m ON m.role_hash = sha256(concat(r.name,':', org_salt))
WHERE m.id IS NULL
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING count(*) > 0;
```
Maya S.: perfect. include that as required for canary lift.
Arjun K.: KMS integration checklist for tonight: 1) ensure KMS key rotation policy documented, 2) fallback to regional key if primary KMS times out, 3) circuit-breaker on KMS client, 4) metrics on sign latency. I'm adding a short patch to the client to return 503->unsigned instead of erroring.
Toni: also ensure audit index retention set to 1y for migration logs, and perms to read them limited to sec+compliance.
Samir: what about the emergency rollback plan?
Maya S.: rollback options: 1) flip feature-flag to legacy rolemap only (instant), 2) run reverse-mapping job using archived role_ids (takes time), 3) if DB migration has mutated canonical rows we can restore from last nightly snapshot (painful). prefer FF flip first.
Lee: can we add a runtime guard: if >1% of canary orgs surface 500s for auth calls, auto rollback FF?
Maya S.: yes will add policy in console: if error_rate(auth) > 1% over 5m -> set ff=legacy.
InfraBot: canary pre-check run complete. missing_defaults report attached: csv link https://artifacts.internal/migrations/1850/missing_defaults.csv
Maya S.: thanks. I looked at the CSV — two medium orgs have missing default_role mappings and one service account with legacy numeric role usage. plan: skip those orgs from initial canary, notify their SRE contacts, and run a targeted backfill after hours.
Samir: if we skip them, we need to ensure their APIs still auth. set them to legacy FF.
Maya S.: done, set FF for org 4321 and 8871.
Arjun K.: test for KMS failover: I pushed a simulated KMS 503 test to staging. token generation returned unsigned header + audit flag. logs look ok.
Toni: runbook updates: add step to check audit_index for migration_run_id and pre-check CSV. add contact list for SREs owning large orgs.
Maya S.: everyone: please ack if you're good with tonight's plan. I'll start the dry-run at 00:30 and post results. :thumbsup:
Samir: ack
Lee: ack
Arjun K.: ack
Toni: ack
InfraBot: scheduled dry-run at 00:30 UTC. notification will post results to thread.
